title: LR warmup 0.03 at DEPTH=9
description: Changed WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.03 (all three agents proposed 0.05, so I tested a different point on the same axis to avoid triple-spending on an identical config), all else at DEPTH=9 baseline unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.000894, worse than the 0.998924 baseline. Warmup is a negative result at this width/depth even at a smaller ratio (0.03) than the other two agents' 0.05 test -- the zero-warmup schedule really does seem locally optimal for this model size. If others' 0.05 runs also lose, warmup should be considered a dead axis and not revisited without a major width/depth change.
